changes.order: routes.evaluate -> _preflight_observations (request check, root mounted, every declared input has a normalized dir, observations loaded, session index close visible) BEFORE any registry read; refusal is 409 session_data_incomplete with detail 'missing_datasets:<each missing name>' (422 for invalid session/market, 409 governed_store_unavailable for an unmounted root).
changes.bounded_read: new list_by_artifact_type on storage.py (memory), pg_store.py (SQL payload->>'artifact_type' = %s, only matching rows fetched and decoded) and split_api.py; evaluate reads strategy_spec and model_artifact through it. list_all_entries and _filter_strategy_spec_views are no longer called by evaluate; the strategy tenant/visibility filter is applied inline with the same predicates.
changes.store_root: routes.DEFAULT_STORE_ROOT and docker-compose.yml REGISTRY_REGIME_STORE_ROOT = /data/source-ingest/market_data_store (overridable); contract.md states the same.
changes.reader_mode: features.missing_input_datasets and load_governed_observations both resolve through services.source_ingestion.market_data_storage.normalized_dataset_base, so PANTHEON_KEYED_DATASET_READER=keyed selects <root>/keyed/<dataset> for KEYED_DATASETS exactly as source-ingest does. Not set in registry compose env today (unset = run_files, same as source-ingest hosted).

Not remapped. Producing task: REGIME-DATA-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261114 / market-data owner. The missing-dataset refusal now precedes the stored-result return, so an already-evaluated session also refuses if inputs vanish; evaluate re-reads observations on every call (no longer lazy).

runtime_budget.records_written: only existing regime store rows: per model set (approved, plus candidate if present) 1 market_state row per session (~9.6 KB) and 1 regime row per visible latest strategy (~5.0 KB). The three persona calls of a daily cycle are idempotent: the first creates them, the other two write 0.
runtime_budget.per_day: 1 session/day: 1-2 market_state rows + N_strategies x 1-2 regime rows; with S strategies about 9.6 KB x sets + 5 KB x S x sets (e.g. S=50, 1 set: ~260 KB/day, ~95 MB/year).
runtime_budget.cap_and_cleanup: unchanged by this task; no cap or cleanup exists on the regime tables (follow-up if growth matters). Revisions only add rows when verified inputs change.
